messages:
maya (eng-runtime): Quick update — we rolled out adaptive microbatching + predictive cache warmup to Hosted API canary this morning. Early aggregate results: p95 latency down 18-23% on long-seq gen, median steady, and token cost ~12% lower on average. :tada:
omar (perf): Nice. Which models/workloads saw the biggest wins?
maya (eng-runtime): Mostly 2x+ seq LLMs (16k+ contexts) and bursty chat traffic. Short chat (<512 tokens) sees negligible change. Perf bench snippet I ran:
```
# synthetic benchmark: 1k requests, seq=8k
./bench --model redwood-large --concurrency 32 --seq 8192 --microbatch adaptive
# p95: 198ms -> 157ms
# cost/token: 1.00 -> 0.88
```
sasha (prod): What's the rollout plan and rollback criteria? Need to know for customers and status page.
maya (eng-runtime): Canary steps: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 6 hours with health checks. Rollback if error rate >0.5% or tail lat spikes >2x baseline. So far at 50% in us-east, error rate steady. deploy-bot: Canary rollout to us-east-1 completed (50%), no alerts triggered. :white_check_mark:
tariq (infra): GPU utilization on the pool increased ~12% due to slightly larger batches, but throughput per-GPU improved 20% so capacity is fine.
omar (perf): Any impact to Dedicated customers or Private packages?
maya (eng-runtime): Dedicated clusters get the update in the next scheduled maintenance window (opt-in). Private deployments will get a config flag; we'll ship docs for enabling predictive warmup. Default for Hosted = on.
sasha (prod): I'll draft a short announcement + changelog. Can we surface the per-model p95 numbers in the console next week?
maya (eng-runtime): Yes — adding a dashboard card and a perf report export. I'll open a PR with the numbers and commit notes.
omar (perf): Minor note: we spotted a rare warmup race on model swap with quantized variants. Patch incoming, delaying 100% rollout by ~2h for one final fix.
maya (eng-runtime): Acknowledged. Thanks all — this should be a good cost win for customers without changing API behavior. I'll post the full bench results and the rollback playbook in #eng-runtime after the fix. :rocket:
